basic_profile.bio: I'm an 18-year-old guy living in Augusta, Georgia. I'm currently taking a gap year after high school to figure out my next steps. My interests are diverse, ranging from gaming, especially Team Fortress 2, to learning about new technology like OLED screens. I'm also getting into eco-friendly practices like composting. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work. I'm single and enjoying meeting new people. Currently working part-time at a local electronics store, which funds my tech hobby and helps me save for college.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong interest in technology and gaming, which I've developed through self-teaching and online communities. My part-time job at an electronics store also gives me hands-on experience with the latest tech gadgets.
